title: Why Applying To More Jobs Makes It Worse
author: Steve Dalton

beats.phrase: You applied to two hundred jobs.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a small monochrome halftone cutout figure stands at the left of the cream stage beneath an enormous towering stack of paper forms, a flat burnt orange disc behind the stack

beats.change_only: the figure's shoulders drop and their head lowers

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a single monochrome paper form cutout taped to the cream stage with a hand-drawn burnt orange marker circle around it

beats.change_only: a burnt orange marker cross stroke draws itself over the circled form

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the oversized monochrome hand lifts one heavy paper form with visible strain, a thick burnt orange stroke bending beneath it
MEDIUM: the same oversized hand flicks a single weightless form away, a burnt orange arrow shooting off to the right

beats.change_only: a dozen more forms shoot off in the same direction

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a dense grid of small monochrome paper forms raining down the cream stage from top to bottom, one single form popped burnt orange among them

beats.change_only: the falling forms double in number and fill the frame edge to edge

beats.scene: MEDIUM: an abstract unlabeled dot-matrix bar on the cream stage, half filled with burnt orange dots rising from the base

beats.change_only: several more burnt orange dots fill upward in the bar

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a monochrome cutout figure at a desk buried to the shoulders in paper forms, a burnt orange half disc low behind them

beats.change_only: a monochrome mesh screen drops down in front of the buried figure

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a torn paper chute on the cream stage swallowing forms into a dark empty gap, a burnt orange stroke marking the opening

beats.phrase: Which teaches you to apply more.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout figure pushing another armful of forms toward the chute, a burnt orange arrow curving in behind them

beats.change_only: the pile around the figure rises above their head

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a large hand-drawn burnt orange arrow drawn as a closed loop on the cream stage, small monochrome forms travelling around it

beats.change_only: the orange loop thickens and more forms crowd onto it

beats.scene: MEDIUM: two abstract unlabeled dot-matrix columns side by side on the cream stage, the left one nearly empty, the right one nearly full of burnt orange dots
CLOSE-UP: the nearly empty dot column alone on the cream stage, a single burnt orange dot at its base, every other dot monochrome

beats.change_only: the single orange dot shrinks to a pinpoint

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the fuller dot column alone on the cream stage, most of its dots burnt orange, a hand-drawn orange underline beneath it

beats.change_only: the orange underline thickens and extends past the column

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a very thin burnt orange wedge separated out of a large monochrome dot field on the cream stage

beats.change_only: the monochrome dot field expands outward, making the orange wedge look far smaller

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a second smaller dot field on the cream stage in which the burnt orange dots now occupy most of the area, monochrome dots pushed to the edge

beats.phrase: So volume is the wrong lever.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a single monochrome lever cutout standing on the cream stage with a burnt orange marker cross stroke drawn over it

beats.change_only: a crowd of small monochrome hands reaches in and grips the lever

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a row of five identical monochrome halftone door cutouts standing across the cream stage, each with an offset burnt orange stroke behind it
MEDIUM: one of the door cutouts tipped forward to show it is a flat paper front with bare cream paper behind it

beats.change_only: a second door in the row tips forward the same way
the space behind the tipped doors is bare cream paper

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the row of doors seen straight on, all identical and upright, a hand-drawn burnt orange marker circle around one of them
MEDIUM: a single monochrome halftone book cutout standing upright at the centre of the cream stage, a flat burnt orange disc behind it

beats.phrase: In The Two Hour Job Search.
beats.change_only: a burnt orange marker circle draws itself around the standing book

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: the wide field of falling monochrome paper forms with one large burnt orange marker cross stroke drawn across the whole field

beats.change_only: the field of forms collapses to four pinned cards at the centre

beats.scene: MEDIUM: two monochrome halftone cutout figures facing each other on the cream stage, a single burnt orange stroke connecting them

beats.change_only: the burnt orange stroke between the two figures thickens

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: four pinned photo cards in a short row on the cream stage with white borders and tape strips, one card popped burnt orange, the towering paper stack gone
